infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Waypoint uses your location to match you with nearby drivers, show live road conditions, and calculate accurate fares.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: While you are on an active trip, Waypoint shares your live location with the trusted contact you chose, and keeps route tracking running so your fare stays accurate and your trip stays protected.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Waypoint uses the camera so you can submit verification documents and photograph road conditions while safely stopped.
